outcomes.original: Estimated time: 120 to 300 days. Estimated government cost: $4,570 to $453,100. Notes: Time to approval: 120–300 days is the combined timeline for the entitlement path (CUA + ABC Type 47 transfer + Health Permit) when all three approvals are granted. The CUA at 414 Columbus Ave (the closest comparable) took 270 days from filing to Commission approval in December 2022. ABC Type 47 transfers in undue-concentration tracts take 90–240 days per the catalog, depending on whether PCN findings, local hearings, or protests extend the investigation. DPH health permit processing is 14–45 days. These approvals are partially sequential (CUA must be approved before ABC will issue, health permit must be in place before ABC's final clearance) so the total path is roughly CUA timeline (120–270 days) plus ABC post-CUA processing (60–120 days) plus DPH in parallel, yielding 120–300 days to all three approvals. Cost range: $4,570 to $453,100 in government fees and license purchase. The minimum assumes the CUA filing fee (~$3,100), the ABC application fee ($1,000 minimum), and the DPH permit fee ($470), totaling ~$4,570. The maximum includes the CUA fee, the ABC fee, the DPH fee, and the high end of the Type 47 license purchase price on the open market ($450,000 per the catalog estimate for SF, though actual market prices fluctuate).
